title: Locally free modules of constant finite rank
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal E$ an $\mathcal O_S$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $d\geq0$ an integer. Then $\mathcal E$ is
*locally free of constant rank $d$* if $S$ has a Zariski
open cover $(V_a)$ with
$\mathcal E|_{V_a}\cong\mathcal O_{V_a}^{\oplus d}$ for every $a$.
In particular $\mathcal E$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]: on an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A=U\subseteq V_a$ one has $\mathcal E|_U\cong\widetilde{A^{\oplus d}}$.
(*Stacks Project, Sheaves of Modules, Tag 01C6 (finite locally free of rank $r$), Tag 01C7 (locally free implies quasi-coherent).*)
